_about: Curated registry fields per Databricks object. Descriptions come from the live Databricks table comment (verified); grain/key for Silver come from the Silver audit inventory, for Gold from the cited documentation, for KPI views from gold/procurement_kpis/kpi_queries.py GRAINS. All grains and keys are re-checked live by metadata/verify_metadata.py.

limitations: Current-state snapshot (projects 2026-10-21, contracts 2026-10-20, financing 2026-09-30, IEG 2026-10-18); status and commitments are not historical values.
Contract values, IBRD/IDA counts and project commitments are separate measures and are never combined.

workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analyti.grain: contract award (one row per current DS00005 contract, 178,921)
workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analyti.grain_source: Databricks table comment and column comment (wb_contract_number = primary key); gold/README.md
limitations: DS00005 contracts signed FY2020 onward only; legacy FY2006-2016 contracts are excluded.
Award-notice links exist only for the 184 projects in the API notice-detail pull; NULL link counts mean not covered, and no_link_found does not prove the contract has no notice.
contract_amount_usd covers all financiers of a contract; it is not an IBRD/IDA amount.

workspace.wbg_gold.gold_procurement_noti.grain: procurement notice (one row per DS00979 notice, 243,533)
workspace.wbg_gold.gold_procurement_noti.grain_source: Databricks table comment; gold/README.md; Silver audit key of procurement_notices (notice_op_id)
limitations: Notices are not contracts: tender invitations, prequalification, expressions of interest, contract-award announcements and general notices are distinguished by notice_class.
Rows with identical metadata are kept and counted as published (identical_metadata_group_size).
Response windows are published windows, not verified tender durations; award-notice and GPN deadlines are source defaults.
Notice-to-contract links exist only for award notices of the 184 API-covered projects; not every tender can be linked to a signed contract.

workspace.wbg_gold.gold_country_context.grain: economy x calendar year (217 economies x 2000-2025, 5,642)
workspace.wbg_gold.gold_country_context.grain_source: Databricks table comment (one row per WDI economy x calendar year)
limitations: Keyed strictly by published calendar year; join lags are not approved, so every join must state the year explicitly.
Current-vintage estimates, not point-in-time observations; regional projects have no country context.

workspace.wbg_gold.gold_financing_analyt.grain: financing instrument (one IBRD loan or IDA credit/grant, 2,685)
workspace.wbg_gold.gold_financing_analyt.grain_source: Databricks table comment and column comment (financing_number = primary key)
limitations: Financing commitments are not contract awards and are never added to contract values.
Published US$ amounts are not on one consistent exchange-rate basis; IBRD currency is not published.
Status and balances are a 2026-09-30 snapshot.
